attributes.title: 2027 AAN Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The 2027 AAN Annual Meeting runs May 1 to 5, 2027, in Washington, DC, and is also offered live online. CME is provided by the American Academy of Neurology Institute, which is ACCME-accredited.

Registration is open. Full registration (in person plus online access) costs neurologist members $920 through February 4, 2027, $1,020 through April 1 and $1,220 after that; nonmembers pay $1,490, $1,650 or $1,970. Intern and junior members pay $350 to $455, students and senior members $30 to $120. Online-only registration starts at $590 for physician members and $950 for nonmembers at the early rate.

Sessions are at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center; the headquarters hotel is the Marriott Marquis Washington, DC, and the AAN hotel block must be booked by April 1, 2027. The total number of CME credits is not listed yet.
